fullContent:
Mayur Piccha Bhasma 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Hikka Swasa chikitsa 16/12 
 INTRODUCTION 
 Mayur Piccha Bhasma is a herbal formulation that is prepared from a very beautiful natural thing, the peacock feathers. Its name Mayur Piccha reflects its ingredients as mayur known as a bird means a peacock. The piccha is the feathers from which bhasma is prepared, are very bright in colour due to its structure. As it consists of tiny holes, through which light gets reflected and provides view of different colours like blue, green and red. This feather consists of active ingredients like iron, zinc. copper and manganese etc. This bhasma is very useful to treat the problem of hiccoughs and dyspnea etc. 
 INGREDIENTS 
 Peacock feathers 
 METHOD OF PREPARATION 
 Take the feather of peacock. Put these feathers into a container. Now close this container and put this on to high fire. Burn the feathers. The ash is obtained after burning the peacock feathers. This ash is known as Mayur Piccha Bhasma. 
 DOSAGE 
 Take bhasma up to 125-130 mg and mix it with honey and one gram long pepper powder. Make its paste and consume. 
 INDICATIONS 
 
 Hiccups 
 Vomiting 
 Nausea 
 Chronic bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 
 CONTRAINDICATIONS 
 No side effects 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
